name: github_list_tree
description: List every file path in the repository at the given branch, recursively, in a single call. Use this to ground a question in what actually exists instead of guessing — e.g. before asking whether something already exists. Read-only; does not return file contents.

branch.description: Branch to list. Defaults to the repository's default branch if omitted.

name: github_read_file
description: Read the current contents of one file from the repository. Use this when seeing how something is currently built would let you ask a sharper, more specific question. Read-only.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, e.g. 'src/App.jsx'.

name: finalize_prompt
description: Call exactly once, only after you have shown the user the exact final prompt as normal chat text and they have explicitly confirmed they're happy with it. This ends the interview and hands off to the building agent, which starts a brand-new session and will NEVER see this conversation — only the `prompt` you pass here. It must therefore be complete and self-contained.

title.description: Short session title, 3-6 words, e.g. 'Add dark mode toggle'.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained brief for the building agent, written as if the user is addressing the builder directly for the first time: what to build, why, constraints, preferences, and everything else decided during the interview. Never reference 'the interview', 'as discussed', or anything the builder has no way of knowing.
